# Arc'teryx Outlet fixtures

These HTML files are synthetic parser-contract fixtures. They reproduce only the standard JSON-LD
and application-state field shapes required by the adapter. They are not downloaded pages and do
not contain current product names, prices, inventory, tracking scripts, or personal information.

All product names, model numbers, SKUs, prices, and stock states are fictional. Tests may use them;
the application must never label them as live retailer data.
